userRequest: Choose an audit component that guarantees a durable audit row in the same transaction as every billing mutation.
successConditions: A committed billing mutation always has a committed audit record.
A rolled-back billing mutation never leaves a committed audit record.

identityFacts: Billing mutations carry verified actor and tenant identifiers.
dataFacts: Billing and audit data must remain in the existing EU PostgreSQL database.
operationalFacts: The managed database plan does not permit shared_preload_libraries or custom extensions.

hardConstraints.statement: The candidate must document participation in the caller's Drizzle PostgreSQL transaction.
Audit data may not be sent to an external service or a region outside eu-central-1.
The solution cannot require a PostgreSQL preload extension.

preferences.statement: Prefer a typed audit event schema enforced in application code.

reasonCodes.description: Audit data must remain inside the existing regional database boundary.
The managed database cannot load a required extension.
Audit persistence must commit and roll back with the business transaction.

unknowns.description: No supplied evidence establishes a Drizzle transaction adapter for the application loggers.
